about: Repair: run 3 (code from before the publish guard) published every model branch at 03:32 UTC, before the guard started, putting back older files (tinyclip-8m-16's vision.int8.onnx became the per-tensor file again; parity.json files went back to stand-in photos). Each branch is rebuilt from its commit before run 3 (GitHub still serves it by sha), keeping files run 3 added that were not there before (species label sets for siglip2-b16, mobileclip2-s0, bioclip-b16); the TinyCLIP cards name the shipping file; every branch gets _files.json.
